name: – Vlad Vasile-Voiculescu – § 20 – Am 14
title: REPORT on the implementation of Europe’s Beating Cancer Plan
part_text: 20. Stresses the need to protect minors from nicotine addiction, including through the effective enforcement of applicable age restrictions on the sale of tobacco and nicotine products, particularly online; insists that any revision of the EU tobacco legislative framework be based on a comprehensive impact assessment, in line with the Better Regulation Guidelines, and on the best available scientific evidence, particularly regarding the differentiated risk profiles of these products and their potential role in reducing smoking-related disease, disability and mortality; emphasises that any proposed measures must be proportionate, take into account the specific characteristics of these products, including emerging ones, include an assessment of their potential impact on illicit trade, and fully respect the principle of subsidiarity and Member States’ competences;
